entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. Yes. I... I think I need to return something? I ordered a helmet and I'm just so confused about the whole process.
I can certainly help you with that. Can you tell me what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
A preference, I guess? The color just wasn't what I thought it would be from the picture. The whole box is still unopened, I haven't even taken it out. I just don't know what to do.
I completely understand. It's important you're happy with your gear, especially something crucial for your safety. Do you have your order number handy?
Um, yes, I think so. It's VF88602. I hope I'm allowed to do this. The website was a little overwhelming.
Not to worry at all. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see your order for the Trail Helmet. It looks like it was delivered 27 days ago. Let me just confirm our policy.
Oh dear, 27 days? Is that bad? Can't you just help me?

It's no problem at all. According to our policy, you have 90 days from the delivery date to return an item, as long as it's in its original condition. Since your box is unopened, you are well within that window. I can go ahead and approve this return for you right now.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! Thank you so much. I was so worried I had done something wrong.

Of course. I am emailing you a prepaid return label as we speak. Just print that out, attach it to the shipping box, and you can drop it off at any designated carrier location. Once we receive the helmet, your refund will be processed.
That's wonderful. Thank you for making it so simple, Isaac.
My pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. Thank you again.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
